prior_liquid_expansion.operation: Remove only the two originally witnessed mount if/endif carriers for an enabled full-development source golden; preserve every original Java/LF byte. This is explicit directive expansion, not normalization or a new artifact pin.

baseline_off: SFM.java retains every released direct SFMTextEditors/SFMTextEditorActions call, original client menu setup callback, import and constructor API when all new client owners are off.
SFMClientRegistrations.java is absent from every release witness and must be omitted when its actual client owner union is empty.
ComputerCraft method and call remain independently owned by computercraft, not any client owner.

Preserve live turtle registration on 1.19.2/1.19.4/1.20/1.20.1/1.20.4/1.21.1, and the originally witnessed no-op adapter on 1.20.2/1.20.3/1.21.0/26.1.2. Presence is not compatible CC runtime evidence.
1.19.2 uses DistExecutor only when the optional client registrar is selected; later target APIs use the original physical-side environment guard.

The historical development-only extra blank after configuration on 1.20 through 1.20.4 stays with the optional client-wiring branch solely for exact source reconstruction; it is not a new semantic feature.

mixed_registrar_compile_gates.gate: Guard fields/factories/imports for actual palette, echo, terminal, control, help, history, panel and other owners. client_actions only authorizes the basic shared registrar shell, not OpenCommandPaletteAction or unrelated actions.
Guard concrete screen-type fields for consent, terminal, explorer, review, history and other owners; workspace_panels only authorizes shared registry infrastructure.
Separate generic explorer shell from file/registry, search/compaction and icon preview rule members before any of those standalone combinations can compile.

packet_actions names the human-facing list/send registrar; remote-status/machine descriptors and multiplayer members require their own existing owners. Do not make common packet transport depend on all human actions.
Java symbol navigation/copy and contextual-action entry share a registrar shell but not blanket ownership.
Basic review-session and newer release-review members must be split in the registrar before accepting independent combinations.
developer_tools names the witnessed developer-world/panel registrar. Typed panel/world implementations and their prerequisites still need review; this is not a client-bootstrap flag.
manager_editor_actions names the witnessed save/save-and-close/close-without-saving registrar. Keep its editor lifecycle and context dependencies separately reviewed.

static_extraction.details: Twenty SFM raw cells plus ten client-registration full cells; the primary already-Liquid registration witness is compared to its explicitly expanded full golden. This is not production renderer evidence.

static_member_predicate_extraction.details: Across ten actual Minecraft selectors, read-only extraction tests the empty, CC-only, basic-action-only, workspace-only and canvas-only masks, each one-owner mask and basic-action-plus-owner masks against pinned full witnesses with exact owned-line removals. These direct flag-expression probes deliberately do not validate registry prerequisites or accept unsupported combinations; production tests will use the real registered prerequisite graph after promotion.
